# 07 split view: blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: PASS.** No blocker or major defects. I found 2 minor issues.
I did not read the diff or src/. I tested only against the spec, 00-cross-cutting and the running app.

## Method
- Stack: `STACK_MODE=dev scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node .verify/qa/07/driver.mjs`. I ran it twice: one full run (`/dev/shm/qa07-run1.log`), then a targeted re-run with `ONLY=...` (`/dev/shm/qa07-run2.log`).
- Driver: `.verify/qa/07/driver.mjs` (Playwright 1.58.2, Chromium). Docs are created through `POST /paste` (legacy-editable, `protected:true`, `mode:'review'`, `contentType:'html'`) and through the dev `?filePath=` loader.
- Raw results are in `.verify/qa/07/results.json`. Screenshots are in `.verify/qa/07/*.png`.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-07.1 PASS: at 1400 the panes sit editor x0 w696, divider x696 w8, preview x704 w696. `.cm-content` is visible, `view-toggle-split` has aria-pressed=true, there is no horizontal scroll and no page errors (ac01-split-1400.png).
- AC-07.2 PASS: the URL becomes `?view=split` and history.length stays at 2. Cycling to edit and then read also leaves history unchanged.
- AC-07.3 PASS: ZEBRA123 appears in the preview within about 3ms.
- AC-07.4 PASS: a 200px drag gives Δ200. Dragging past the edge stops both panes at a 240px minimum. Reload restores 850→850. Double-click gives a share of 0.500. The divider has role/orientation/tabindex and `md-review-split-ratio` is stored.
- AC-07.5 PASS: ArrowRight ×2 moves 50→60. Home→17 (editor 240px) and End→83 (preview 240px). aria min/max is 17/83.
- AC-07.6 PASS: editor top line 139.99, and the preview H2 for line 140 sits at +0.5px.
- AC-07.7 PASS: preview heading 200 at the top puts the editor's top line at 200.01.
- AC-07.8 PASS: bottom and top clamp in both directions (scrollTop+clientHeight ≥ scrollHeight−2, and top 0).
- AC-07.9 PASS: sync is on by default. After toggling: aria-pressed=false and ls `"0"`. Preview scrollTop stays 0→0 while the editor scrolls. The toggle is still off after reload.
- AC-07.10 PASS: editor at 50% gives an iframe ratio of 0.500. Iframe at bottom puts the editor at the bottom (ac10-html-bottom.png).
- AC-07.11 PASS: 10 keystrokes cause 1 iframe navigation. Afterwards the iframe scrollTop is 3051 (ratio 0.500) and the text is updated.
- AC-07.12 PASS: with sync off, the preview stays at 2000 after typing (exactly 2000).
- AC-07.13 PASS at 820×1180 and 390×844: tabs are visible, Edit is the default (aria-selected), only one pane shows at a time, the divider is absent, there is no horizontal scroll, and `?view=split` is kept. The phone toggle is icon-only with aria-labels (ac13-*.png).
- AC-07.14 PASS (with one caveat, minor #1 below): edits survive a tab round-trip. Ctrl+Z undoes the last edit (OMEGA) and keeps ALPHA, so the editor was not remounted.
- AC-07.15 PASS: h1 has data-line-start=4 and sits at +0.39px when line 4 is the editor's top line.
- AC-07.16 PASS: a protected doc without a token shows the read view, `view=read`, no split toggle and no editor. Token holder: split works. Pinned `@rev`: read view and `view=read`. With `embed=1`: read view, and the param is not rewritten (per §1.3).
- AC-07.17 PASS: selecting in the preview shows the `.selection-action-bar` and the Comment popover opens. Selecting in the editor also shows the bar. The comments aside sits right of the split view (ac17-selection-bar.png).

## Edge cases (all PASS unless noted)
- Ping-pong: 12 rapid alternating wheels across both panes, then scrollTop is stable across 6 samples after 500ms.
- Real wheel scroll: the preview follows.
- Empty doc and short doc: no scroll, no errors.
- Interpolation inside a 150-line fenced code block: −13px.
- Heading after a tall mermaid diagram (once rendered) aligns at 0px.
- HTML doc with no `<body>`, and HTML whose script grows it after load: editor at bottom gives iframe ratio 1.0.
- HTML debounce burst: 40 chars at 20ms intervals cause 1 iframe load.
- Resizing across 960 four times while typing: content, focus and caret are kept and undo still works.
- Touch-dragging the divider at 1000×800 (CDP touch events): −100px gives exactly −100px. touch-action is none.
- Invalid localStorage (`banana`) falls back to 50. A value of `99` is clamped so the preview is 240px.
- `?filePath=…&view=split` dev loader works.
- Autosave from split view reaches the server.
- All 6 themes: the panes and divider follow the theme tokens (theme-*.png). No defects spotted.
- Back/forward: correct. View changes add no history entries.

## Defects
1. **minor**: switching narrow tabs does not return focus to the editor.
   - Repro: at 820px in split view, type, click `split-tab-preview`, click `split-tab-edit`, press Ctrl+Z.
   - Result: focus stays on the tab button and nothing is undone. Read literally, AC-07.14 fails here.
   - It works once the editor is clicked. This matches §3.5 ("Mod+Z: editor focused"), but focusing the editor when its tab is activated would be friendlier.
2. **minor (a11y)**: the divider cannot be reached by Tab moving forward.
   - CodeMirror captures Tab (the #9 indent behaviour), so 45 Tab presses from load never leave the editor.
   - Shift+Tab from `split-sync-toggle` does reach the divider. This comes from #9 rather than #7, but it should be known.

## Not covered
- Rule 13: the comment-sidebar "scroll to" scrolling both panes. I had no API path to seed anchored comments in the time-box.
- Rule 14: the lazy-editor placeholder under a slow network.
